summary: No inspected trial satisfies the full source-preservation and CoD-animation contract. regional127-v2 is a useful bind/linker reference but is only a six-island approximation with no directly tracked weighted source joints.

strictContractFeasibility.conflict: Exact original SMD numeric weights cannot coexist with a minimum serialized weight of 0.0101.
strictContractFeasibility.requiredBuilderBehavior: Fail closed and require an explicit canonical-weight decision. Do not label the reduced/floored weight set as exact original weights.

sourceFacts.twistContract: j_wristtwist1..6_le and j_wristtwist1..6_ri are sibling children of their respective elbow joints

full127-wrist-v1.explanation: Every weighted source joint in an arm receives the same wrist-global delta. The surface is rigid, so strain vanishes, but shoulder, elbow, wrist, twist, and finger articulation also vanish.

regional127-v2.realRisk: Mixed-weight vertices span independently driven shoulder, elbow, and wrist islands; digits and twist helpers never articulate relative to their island roots.

genericContractMismatches: The 56 xi_src_* joints are expected extras when --allow-extra-joints is used.
sharedJointCount=0 follows from the alias-weight architecture and makes bind-center registration inapplicable as written.
The identical Unlinker crashes on pristine stock71 and regional127 are a tool/control limitation, not candidate-specific evidence.
realRuntimeOrDeformationRisks: No regional weighted alias has a direct XAnim track.
Only six broad helper islands inherit motion; all 34 weighted digit and palm aliases remain rigid relative to each wrist island.
Four source weighted parent links are cut at shoulder/elbow/wrist region boundaries.
Regional mixed-weight edges stretch up to 6.243x in dense evidence and six dense frames fail side shape.
OAT linking does not exercise live animation, engine bone limits, weapon interaction, or first-person rendering.
validatorInterpretation.falseComfort: The generic edge gate compares against the stock mesh's already large edge ratios and permits an OR-based maximum-edge exception. It is not a source-preservation gate.

smallestArchitecture.helperParentRule: Every helper is a direct child of j_elbow_le or j_elbow_ri as appropriate.
smallestArchitecture.digitMapping: Map each source digit _1,_2,_3 injectively to CoD _0,_1,_2; retain CoD _3 controls unweighted.
smallestArchitecture.palmMapping: Map source ringbase/pinkybase to CoD ringpalm/pinkypalm.
smallestArchitecture.bindRule: Use only rigid transforms per disconnected source arm component, derive mapped control locals from the retained source global binds, and regenerate coherent inverse binds for every skin slot.
smallestArchitecture.animationRule: Retarget and bake each required CoD XAnim into source-bind-aware local tracks for all 50 mapped controls and derive tracks for the six helpers. Preserve sibling twists; never accumulate twist1..6 serially.
smallestArchitecture.activeParallelAlternative: A 127-joint stock71 plus source56 layer is viable only if an actual per-joint constraint system or xi_src_* animation tracks are executed. Parent inheritance alone is insufficient.

independentSourceSurfaceBar.maximumEdgeRatioException: Only for a final animated edge no longer than 0.25 units and with explicit visual clearance.

builderRecommendation: Stop promotion of every current trial, including regional127-v2.
Resolve the exact-original-weight versus 0.0101-floor contradiction before another candidate build.
Reuse regional127-v2's exact stock prefix and coherent bind/inverse-bind construction, not its six-island driving policy.
Implement the 77-joint injective semantic layout and a source-bind-aware XAnim retarget/bake stage.
If legacy XAnims must remain untouched and no active constraint path exists, declare the strict build infeasible rather than adding another passive driver layer.
Run independent eight-motion and dense-frame source-surface gates, pristine OAT linking, and a live CoD4 first-person test before promotion.
